biggest_catch: The $50-per-product payout only lands after the friend meets steep requirements - a $500/month direct deposit with eStatements within 90 days for checking, or a $10,000+ auto loan - and both bonuses post about 90 days after qualifications are met.
catches: Friend must be a new member: no First Northern account for at least one year, 18+, and must use promo code REFER at account opening.
Checking tier: friend must establish $500/month direct deposit and enroll in eStatements within 90 days of account opening; minimum $5 share savings balance.
Auto-loan tier: new/used/refinanced auto loan of at least $10,000 (excludes indirect, Rate Genius, and Driving Sense loans); subject to credit approval.
Earnings deposited to each member's share savings account approximately 90 days after qualifications are met; member must be in good standing; employees/officers ineligible.
No limit on number of referrals; program subject to change without notice; cannot combine with other offers.
